_comment: Execution order for db/migrations. THIS FILE IS THE ORDER - not the filename sort.
Alphabetical order is provably wrong here: migration_exports_advances.sql creates
advance_adjustments, which has a foreign key to receipt_vouchers, created by
migration_vouchers.sql - and 'exports' sorts before 'vouchers'. Running them
alphabetically against a database that predates both fails with 42P01. That is not
hypothetical; it happened in production on 2026-08-12.
The order below is the order the files were added to the repository, which is the
order they were written to be applied in.
Adding a migration: create db/migrations/NNN_short_description.sql using the next
free number, and append its filename to the end of 'order'. The runner refuses to
start if the directory and this list disagree, so a file cannot be silently skipped.
